manual_checks.name: Xiaomi MiMo

manual_checks.name: SB Intuitions
manual_checks.note: Check Japanese developer releases and exact API successor names alongside open checkpoints; hosted models may not appear in weight inventories. Separate speech encoders, dedicated ASR/TTS and moderation classifiers from generative dialogue.

manual_checks.note: Check Japanese announcements and company-trained variants, including domain models. Resolve renamed repositories and distinguish configured context from verified training/support limits.

manual_checks.name: Pleias
manual_checks.note: Check original base, reasoning and specialized company releases, including trained models bundled inside applications. Keep first external access separate from paper dates and later open-weight publication.

manual_checks.name: Sevren
manual_checks.note: Check original pretrained model releases; BF16 and quantized deployment copies are one trained identity.

manual_checks.name: Retell
manual_checks.note: Check named trained model versions and promised access dates separately from voice-platform releases.

manual_checks.name: Bland
manual_checks.note: Speech-native generative dialogue qualifies. Preview requests do not establish external access.

manual_checks.name: Hark
manual_checks.note: Check trained Handoff model revisions separately from service plans and inference speed changes.

manual_checks.name: LG AI Research
manual_checks.note: Check hosted successors and original public checkpoints separately; exact-model active parameters and licenses can differ between releases.

manual_checks.name: Kakao
manual_checks.note: Review Kanana language and vision-language releases; dedicated embeddings, encoders and classifiers require separate scope review.

manual_checks.name: NAVER HyperCLOVA X
manual_checks.note: Check original SEED language and conversational multimodal releases; do not infer complete size from the language backbone.

manual_checks.name: SK Telecom
manual_checks.note: Check trained A.X releases and audio-language variants; quantized copies, draft models and vision encoders are not independent dialogue models.

manual_checks.name: Upstage
manual_checks.note: Check hosted Solar revisions alongside original open and small research models; tokenizers alone do not establish weight access.
